records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days post-signup with zero product activity: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and no tickets or replies to the welcome email [email:3b734a8d]. Fully silent accounts rarely self-start in the remaining 8 days, though Starter self-serve activation is still possible.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first project started
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Checking in since my welcome note last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one project is usually the easiest first step. There's also an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
